name: Dispel Cold
body:
School abjuration [fire]; Level druid 5, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, shaman 5

This spell functions as dispel evil, except it surrounds you in a warm yellow-orange aura and it affects cold creatures rather than evil ones.
